profile.summary: Aastha Spintex Limited manufactures and trades in cotton yarns and bales for knitting and weaving applications in India. The company offers carded, FLAT, combed, and compact combed cotton yarns; and cotton waste by-products, such as comber, licker-in, and hard waste and cotton seeds.
